The provided text shows all lines aligned to the left margin. Consequently, when analyzing this malformed text, the expert incorrectly identifies "indented" lines (like "and becomes less" and "until there is nothing left") based on line breaks or arbitrary spacing rather than actual indentation. In the actual poem, the indentation occurs in the **fourth** stanza (starting with "I have not ever seen my father's grave..."), where lines like "yet tonight" and "his heavy steps" are indented. Because the Poetry_Expert's provided text lacked the necessary visual cues (indentation) to perform the analysis correctly, the entire subsequent analysis and conclusion (identifying Stanza 3) are based on false premises. The Literature_Expert and Computer_terminal acted as conduits, but the source of the error was the failure to retrieve or format the text correctly in the initial analysis step.
